description.from:
Repo: **Papyrus**. Phase 5 of PPY-452419: the client island that makes a static thread page interactive. Rendering decision (epic decision 6): static page + island, not SSR.

## Files
- New island `src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/assets/papyrus-forum.js` (+ `.css`), published as `_plugins/papyrus-forum-v1.js` next to the islands runtime (`projector.py` `ISLANDS_RUNTIME_PATH` ~98/136; the `_body()` injection ~1225-1232 keys on `data-island="`). Vanilla JS like `papyrus-reader@1.js` (no React on public pages).
- `forum_pages.py` emits `::island{name="forum-thread" props='{"key": "...", "subject": ...}'}` at the end of a thread page and `::island{name="forum-new-thread"}` on a Reference/Story page when `posting.subjects` allows it (via `blocks.py` `_island_html`, `IslandSettings(script, stylesheet, prerender)`; the prerendered HTML is the static Message list, so no-JS readers see everything).
- Behaviour: on load, GET the reader session (`/api/reader/me`, existing) and show either "Sign in with Google to post" (Lucide `log-in`, the `ReaderSignIn` flow from `papyrus-reader@1.js`) or the post box (textarea + one **Post** button, `message-square-plus`; Reply opens the same box in place with `reply`); on submit POST `/api/reader/post`, append the Message optimistically with "posting..." text and a `loader` icon, then replace with the server copy; on failure keep the text in the box (the `use-reference-ratings.ts` pattern) and show the error text; re-fetch `_data/home-page/threads/<key>.json` with `cache: "no-store"` on focus to pick up others' posts (the snapshot lags by the debounce window; say so in a small "updated <time>" line). A `pending` (moderation) post shows to its author only with a `clock` icon and the text "waiting for review".
- Flat tones, rounded rectangles, no borders; every state has an icon plus text.

## Gherkin (`features/forum-island.feature`, Playwright at 375 and 1440 px, synthetic data, `@brand-agnostic`)
Feature: The forum island
  Scenario: Without JavaScript the thread page shows every Message and no post box
  Scenario: A guest sees the Google sign-in prompt and no password field
  Scenario: A signed-in reader posts and sees the Message at once
  Scenario: A failed post keeps the typed text
  Scenario: A post held for review is shown only to its author with the review text
  Scenario: No element on the page has a border

## Acceptance
- `npm run test:features` profile for the island; `docs/home-page.md` "Forum island"; the island is listed in the islands docs (`docs/building-a-papyrus-static-site.md`).
- Blocked by the posting task (route contract) and the thread-pages task (page to mount on).
